projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z;quarterly probes,not monthly means or annual envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior maximum of complete finite50–200m eastward integral with subsurface peak greater than finite surface flow;resolved primary10cm/s lower contour;axis identity remains unvalidated.
projections.branch_scope: Partial central/eastern Indian EUC-context70–90E reach within2S–2N. Distinguish subsurface-enhanced eastward candidate flow from surface-dominated Wyrtki jets,monsoon currents and neighboring circulation;relative velocity comparison does not independently establish that distinction. Native0m comparison is not a water-mass or thermal criterion. No thermocline classification or at-least-month persistence is verified. Historical90E moorings/2017 section remain distinct from2022 model snapshots. Out-of-gate branches,western formation and full annual behavior remain unsearched.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.
